notes: A true run requires a real dispatch module that compiles or exposes multiple recurrence-preserving selective-scan BLOCK_SIZE variants. Chunked sequence emulation is intentionally not used because it resets scan state at chunk boundaries unless the kernel accepts an initial state.

dispatch_info.fallback_hint: Set COREY_SELECTIVE_SCAN_BACKEND=original to force the stock path, or COREY_SELECTIVE_SCAN_BACKEND=chunked_emulation for debug-only chunk routing that is not recurrence-preserving.

probe.error: TypeError('original backend does not honor runtime chunk_size')
